budgetEnforcement.modelRequests: Hard actual provider.decide entry allowance. SDK task usage may include a reservation rejected before the provider call.
budgetEnforcement.rounds: Hard new createSession entry allowance; existing resumed session does not consume a new slot; failed creation consumes a slot.
budgetEnforcement.actions: Soft threshold of distinct SDK action.started IDs, reconciled to final new attempts. In-flight recovery may exceed it. No SDK hook, public execute/probe rejection or old-session budget mutation added.
budgetEnforcement.durationMs: Provider/session calls check the deadline; timer requests pause. In-flight SDK work settles and may overrun. Summary reports actual overshoot.
budgetEnforcement.cancellation: New recovery API calls reject when stopping is already set. A recovery already inside SDK internals settles intact; no internal-attempt immediate-stop claim.

metricLimits: browserOperationKey plus arrival conditions is a candidate hint, not semantic uniqueness, equivalent identity or coverage proof; shared-name/identifier collisions remain possible.
Missing source targets, unresolved identity or missing conditions produce unkeyed successful attempts and conservatively defer progress/repeated-route guards while those successes remain valid.
Live executing attempts are disclosed separately; preexisting or settled executing attempts still block acceptance.
Latest attempt status replaces event-counting; final reconciliation retracts successes that became unknown and recalculates candidate progress.
Plan resolution deltas include persisted occurrence handles so duplicate business IDs remain independent.
Provider usage is parsed-answer usage, not billing reconciliation. Shutdown waits up to 5 seconds for underlying calls and explicitly lists any remaining request IDs.

Diagnostic writes never throw through SDK callbacks; resource cleanup proceeds independently after individual failures. A full disk may prevent the summary file itself, so console failure and exit status remain necessary.
